decision: User-requested follow-up audit: remove unrelated legacy CSS/Sass/JavaScript before proceeding with feature migration.

retained.bootstrap: All pinned core modules and upstream compatibility behavior, plus the six approved security/accessibility exceptions.
retained.dependencies: Required node_modules, calendar/Floating UI assets and hash-verified Bootstrap reference caches are not obsolete Tremplin code.
retained.extensionsAndThemes: Current optional components and Ocean/Forest presets remain, with legacy fallback branches replaced by strict tokens.
retained.fixtures: Root examples and documentation/test strings still used by the pending migration suite are inputs, not alternate framework implementations. Do not delete useful regression coverage by searching for old class names.
retained.evidence: Historical non-executable reports and screenshots remain evidence; obsolete executable runtime copies and the old transient trace CSS cache are removed.
